nodes.name: Note

nodes.name: Color Picker
nodes.description: A color chosen with a picker.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: The chosen color.

nodes.name: Color.ByARGB
nodes.description: Creates a color from alpha, red, green and blue values (0-255).

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: Alpha channel, 0–255 (default fully opaque).

inputs.name: r
inputs.description: Red channel, 0–255.

inputs.name: g
inputs.description: Green channel, 0–255.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: Blue channel, 0–255.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: The color.

nodes.name: Color.ByHSV
nodes.description: Creates a color from hue (degrees, wraps around), saturation and value (0-1, clamped).

inputs.name: hue
inputs.description: Hue in degrees (0 = red, 120 = green, 240 = blue); wraps around.

inputs.name: saturation
inputs.description: Saturation, 0 (grey) to 1 (vivid); clamped.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value (brightness), 0 (black) to 1 (full); clamped.

inputs.name: alpha
inputs.description: Alpha channel, 0–255 (default fully opaque).

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: The color.

nodes.name: Color.ByValues
nodes.description: One color per value, equal values sharing a color — feed parameter values in, feed the colors to Appearance.OverrideColor per group, and use the uniqueValues/uniqueColors legend for reports. Optional own palette (cycled).

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: One value per element (property values, numbers, names, ...).

inputs.name: colors
inputs.description: Optional palette: colors or "#RRGGBB" strings, used in order and cycled.

nodes.returns: A color per input value, and the distinct values with their colors (index-aligned legend).

nodes.name: Color.Components
nodes.description: Splits a color into its red, green, blue and alpha channels (0-255).

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: The color to decompose.

nodes.returns: Dictionary with "red", "green", "blue" and "alpha" values (0-255).

nodes.name: Color.ContrastText
nodes.description: Black or white, whichever reads better on a background color (WCAG contrast) — for labels on coloured fills and legends.

inputs.name: background
inputs.description: The fill color the text will sit on.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: Opaque black or opaque white.

nodes.name: Color.Darken
nodes.description: Makes a color darker by shifting its HSL lightness down by amount (0-1, clamped); alpha is kept.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: The color to darken.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: How much lightness to remove, 0 (none) to 1 (black); clamped.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: The darker color.

nodes.name: Color.FromHex
nodes.description: Parses a hex color string ("#RRGGBB" or "#AARRGGBB").

inputs.name: hex
inputs.description: The hex string, e.g. "#FF8800".

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: The parsed color.

nodes.name: Color.Gradient
nodes.description: A list of N colors evenly blended between two colors (endpoints included; defaults blue to red) — for heat-map style legends and value ramps.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: How many colors to generate (at least 1).

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: First color of the gradient (empty = blue).

inputs.name: end
inputs.description: Last color of the gradient (empty = red).

outputs.name: colors
outputs.description: The gradient colors, start to end.

nodes.name: Color.Invert
nodes.description: Inverts a color's red, green and blue channels (the photographic negative); alpha is kept.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: The color to invert.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: The inverted color.

nodes.name: Color.Lerp
nodes.description: Interpolates between two colors (t clamped to 0-1).

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: Color at t = 0.

inputs.name: end
inputs.description: Color at t = 1.

inputs.name: t
inputs.description: Interpolation parameter (clamped to 0–1).

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: The interpolated color.

nodes.name: Color.Lighten
nodes.description: Makes a color lighter by shifting its HSL lightness up by amount (0-1, clamped); alpha is kept.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: The color to lighten.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: How much lightness to add, 0 (none) to 1 (white); clamped.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: The lighter color.

nodes.name: Color.Palette
nodes.description: A named palette as a list of colors: colourblind-safe, tableau, pastel, status (green/amber/red/grey) or the viridis, heat and grey ramps interpolated to count; fixed palettes cycle past their size.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Palette name: colourblind, tableau, pastel, status, viridis, heat or grey.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: How many colors to return (1–256).

outputs.name: colors
outputs.description: The palette colors.

nodes.name: Color.Random
nodes.description: A pseudo-random color, stable per seed: the same seed always gives the same color (re-runs stay consistent); change the seed for another one.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Any number; each seed maps to one fixed color.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: The color.

nodes.name: Color.RandomList
nodes.description: A list of visually distinct pseudo-random colors (golden-angle hues), stable per seed — ideal for coloring N groups apart.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: How many colors to generate (at least 1).

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Any number; each seed yields one fixed sequence.

outputs.name: colors
outputs.description: The colors.

nodes.name: Color.ToHex
nodes.description: Formats a color as hex text, "#RRGGBB" (or "#AARRGGBB" with includeAlpha) — the reverse of Color.FromHex.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: The color to format.

inputs.name: includeAlpha
inputs.description: True to prefix the alpha channel ("#AARRGGBB"); false drops it ("#RRGGBB").

outputs.name: hex
outputs.description: The hex text.

nodes.name: Color.ToHSV
nodes.description: Splits a color into hue (degrees, 0-360), saturation and value (0-1); greys have hue 0.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: The color to decompose.

nodes.returns: Dictionary with "hue" (0–360, 0 for greys), "saturation" and "value" (0–1).

nodes.name: Color.WithAlpha
nodes.description: Returns a color with its alpha (opacity) replaced, 0 = transparent to 255 = opaque; red, green and blue are unchanged.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: The color to change.

inputs.name: alpha
inputs.description: The new alpha, 0 (transparent) to 255 (opaque); clamped.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: The color with the new alpha.

nodes.name: JSON.Parse
nodes.description: Parses a JSON string into dictionaries, lists and values.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: The JSON text to parse.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The parsed value (dictionary, list, number, string, boolean or null).

nodes.name: JSON.Stringify
nodes.description: Serializes any value to a JSON string.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The value to serialize.

inputs.name: indented
inputs.description: True (default) for pretty-printed output.

outputs.name: json
outputs.description: The JSON text.

nodes.name: Snapshot.Diff
nodes.description: Diffs two GUID-keyed dictionaries: added/removed/changed keys (values compared by JSON equality; nested dictionary key order is ignored).

inputs.name: oldValue
inputs.description: The older snapshot dictionary.

inputs.name: newValue
inputs.description: The newer snapshot dictionary.

nodes.returns: Dictionary with "addedKeys", "removedKeys" and "changedKeys".

nodes.name: XML.Parse
nodes.description: Parses XML into dictionaries, lists and strings (attributes as "@name", repeated elements as lists, mixed text as "#text").

inputs.name: xml
inputs.description: The XML text to parse.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The parsed value (dictionary of dictionaries/lists/strings).

nodes.name: DateTime.AddDays
nodes.description: Offsets a date/time by a number of days (fractional and negative values allowed).

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time to offset.

inputs.name: days
inputs.description: Days to add (fractional and negative values allowed).

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The offset date/time.

nodes.name: DateTime.AddHours
nodes.description: Adds hours to a date/time (fractional and negative values allowed).

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time to offset.

inputs.name: hours
inputs.description: Hours to add (fractional and negative values allowed).

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The offset date/time.

nodes.name: DateTime.AddMinutes
nodes.description: Adds minutes to a date/time (fractional and negative values allowed).

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time to offset.

inputs.name: minutes
inputs.description: Minutes to add (fractional and negative values allowed).

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The offset date/time.

nodes.name: DateTime.AddMonths
nodes.description: Adds calendar months to a date/time (the day clamps to the end of a shorter month).

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time to offset.

inputs.name: months
inputs.description: Months to add (negative values allowed).

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The offset date/time.

nodes.name: DateTime.AddYears
nodes.description: Adds calendar years to a date/time (29 February clamps to 28 February in a common year).

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time to offset.

inputs.name: years
inputs.description: Years to add (negative values allowed).

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The offset date/time.

nodes.name: DateTime.AgeInDays
nodes.description: Returns how many days old a date/time is at a reference date/time (reference minus date; fractional days included).

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time to measure the age of, e.g. when a clash was created.

inputs.name: reference
inputs.description: The date/time to measure up to, e.g. DateTime.Now.

outputs.name: days
outputs.description: The age in days (reference minus dateTime).

nodes.name: DateTime.ByDate
nodes.description: Creates a date from year, month and day numbers.

inputs.name: year
inputs.description: Year, e.g. 2026.

inputs.name: month
inputs.description: Month, 1-12.

inputs.name: day
inputs.description: Day of month, 1-31.

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The date at midnight.

nodes.name: DateTime.Compare
nodes.description: Compares two date/times: -1 when the first is earlier, 0 when equal, 1 when it is later.

inputs.name: a
inputs.description: The first date/time.

inputs.name: b
inputs.description: The second date/time.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: -1 when a is earlier than b, 0 when they are equal, 1 when a is later than b.

nodes.name: DateTime.Components
nodes.description: Splits a date/time into year, month, day, hour, minute, second, English weekday name, day of year, ISO week, ISO year and quarter.

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time to split.

nodes.returns: Dictionary with "year", "month", "day", "hour", "minute", "second", "weekday", "dayOfYear", "isoWeek", "isoYear" and "quarter".

nodes.name: DateTime.DaysBetween
nodes.description: Returns the signed number of days between two date/times (end minus start).

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: The starting date/time.

inputs.name: end
inputs.description: The ending date/time.

outputs.name: days
outputs.description: The signed day difference.

nodes.name: DateTime.EndOf
nodes.description: Returns the last millisecond of the day, week, month, quarter or year containing a date/time (start of the next period minus 1 ms).

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time inside the period.

inputs.name: unit
inputs.description: "day", "week", "month", "quarter" or "year" (any case).

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: "Monday" or "Sunday" (any case); only used for "week".

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The start of the next period minus one millisecond.

nodes.name: DateTime.Format
nodes.description: Formats a date/time as text using a .NET format string (invariant culture).

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time to format.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: .NET date format string.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The formatted text.

nodes.name: DateTime.FromUnixSeconds
nodes.description: Converts Unix seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC to a (UTC) date/time.

inputs.name: seconds
inputs.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch (negative before 1970).

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The date/time, with kind UTC.

nodes.name: DateTime.Now
nodes.description: Returns the current local date and time (captured at execution).

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The current local date and time.

nodes.name: DateTime.Parse
nodes.description: Parses text as a date/time, optionally with an exact .NET format string.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The text to parse.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Optional exact .NET date format string.

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The parsed date/time.

nodes.name: DateTime.Range
nodes.description: Creates a list of dates from a start to an end (both included) with a step in days; at most 100000 items.

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: The first date.

inputs.name: end
inputs.description: The last date (included when the step lands on it).

inputs.name: stepDays
inputs.description: Days between two items; must be greater than 0.

outputs.name: dates
outputs.description: The dates, in order.

nodes.name: DateTime.StartOf
nodes.description: Returns midnight at the start of the day, week, month, quarter or year containing a date/time.

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time inside the period.

inputs.name: unit
inputs.description: "day", "week", "month", "quarter" or "year" (any case).

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: "Monday" or "Sunday" (any case); only used for "week".

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The first instant (00:00:00) of the period.

nodes.name: DateTime.Today
nodes.description: Returns today's local date at midnight (captured at execution).

outputs.name: dateTime
outputs.description: The local date at 00:00:00.

nodes.name: DateTime.ToUnixSeconds
nodes.description: Converts a date/time to Unix seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC (a value without a time zone is taken as UTC).

inputs.name: dateTime
inputs.description: The date/time to convert.

outputs.name: seconds
outputs.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch (negative before 1970).

nodes.name: Dictionary.ByKeysValues
nodes.description: Creates a dictionary from a list of keys and a list of values of the same length.

inputs.name: keys
inputs.description: The keys (converted to strings).

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: The values, one per key.

outputs.name: dictionary
outputs.description: The new dictionary.

nodes.name: Dictionary.ContainsKey
nodes.description: Tests whether a dictionary has the given key (case-sensitive).

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to look in.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key to look for.

outputs.name: hasKey
outputs.description: True when the dictionary has the key.

nodes.name: Dictionary.Count
nodes.description: Returns the number of entries in a dictionary.

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to measure.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: The number of keys.

nodes.name: Dictionary.FromRows
nodes.description: Builds a dictionary from a list of [key, value] rows (a later row wins for a repeated key).

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: A list of rows, each a list with the key in cell 0 and the value in cell 1.

outputs.name: dictionary
outputs.description: The new dictionary.

nodes.name: Dictionary.Invert
nodes.description: Swaps keys and values into a new dictionary (values become text keys; for equal values the last entry wins).

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to invert.

outputs.name: dictionary
outputs.description: A new dictionary from value text to the old key.

nodes.name: Dictionary.Keys
nodes.description: Returns all keys of a dictionary as a list.

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to read from.

outputs.name: keys
outputs.description: The keys as a list of strings.

nodes.name: Dictionary.Merge
nodes.description: Combines several dictionaries into a new one; for a repeated key the later dictionary wins.

inputs.name: dictionaries
inputs.description: The dictionaries to combine, earliest first.

outputs.name: dictionary
outputs.description: A new dictionary with the keys of all of them.

nodes.name: Dictionary.RemoveKey
nodes.description: Returns a copy of the dictionary without the given key (a missing key is fine).

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to copy.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key to leave out.

outputs.name: dictionary
outputs.description: A new dictionary without the key.

nodes.name: Dictionary.SetValueAtKey
nodes.description: Returns a copy of the dictionary with the given key set or updated.

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to copy.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key to set.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The value to store under the key.

outputs.name: dictionary
outputs.description: A new dictionary with the key set.

nodes.name: Dictionary.ToRows
nodes.description: Converts a dictionary to a list of [key, value] rows.

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to convert.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.description: A list of [key, value] rows; the key is text.

nodes.name: Dictionary.ValueAtKey
nodes.description: Returns the value stored under the given key.

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to read from.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key to look up.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The value stored under the key.

nodes.name: Dictionary.ValueOrDefault
nodes.description: Returns the value stored under a key, or a default value when the key is missing.

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to read from.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The key to look up.

inputs.name: defaultValue
inputs.description: Returned when the key is missing (null when left unwired).

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The stored value, or the default.

nodes.name: Dictionary.Values
nodes.description: Returns all values of a dictionary as a list.

inputs.name: dictionary
inputs.description: The dictionary to read from.

outputs.name: values
outputs.description: The values as a list.

nodes.name: Watch
nodes.description: Displays the incoming value. A long list shows its first 1,000 items and a count of the rest; the value itself passes through whole. When the node does not run (an input failed, was switched off or is not connected) the display is cleared.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The value to display.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The incoming value, passed through.

nodes.name: Watch Image
nodes.description: Displays the image file at the incoming path (PNG, JPG, BMP). Given a list of paths it shows the first image and says how many there are. When the node does not run the picture is cleared.

inputs.name: imagePath
inputs.description: Path of the image file to display, or a list of paths (the first is shown).

outputs.name: imagePath
outputs.description: The incoming path, passed through.

nodes.name: Watch List
nodes.description: Displays the elements of a list, one per line. A very long list shows its first 2,000 elements and a count of the rest; the value itself passes through whole. When the node does not run the display is cleared.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: The list (or value) to display.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: The incoming value, passed through.

nodes.name: Watch Table
nodes.description: Displays a table as a grid: column names on top, one line per row. The grid draws the first 2,000 rows (the summary says how many there are); the value itself passes through whole. When the node does not run the display is cleared.

inputs.name: table
inputs.description: The table (or rows, or dictionaries) to display.

outputs.name: table
outputs.description: The incoming value, passed through.

nodes.name: CSV.AppendToFile
nodes.description: Appends rows to a CSV file (same quoting as CSV.WriteToFile), writing the optional headers only when the file is new or empty.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The CSV file to append to.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: List of rows (each row a list of cell values; a scalar becomes a one-cell row).

inputs.name: delimiter
inputs.description: Single-character cell delimiter.

inputs.name: headers
inputs.description: Optional header cells, written once when the file is new or empty.

outputs.name: path
outputs.description: The path that was written, for sequencing further file nodes.

nodes.name: CSV.ReadFromFile
nodes.description: Reads a CSV file into a list of rows (numeric cells become numbers).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Path to the CSV file.

inputs.name: delimiter
inputs.description: Single-character cell delimiter.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: List of rows; each row is a list of numbers/strings.

nodes.name: CSV.WriteToFile
nodes.description: Writes a list of rows to a CSV file (overwrites; creates missing directories).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Destination file path.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: List of rows (each row a list of cell values).

inputs.name: delimiter
inputs.description: Single-character cell delimiter.

outputs.name: path
outputs.description: The path that was written, for sequencing further file nodes.

nodes.name: Directory.Create
nodes.description: Creates a folder including any missing parent folders (does nothing when it already exists).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The folder to create.

outputs.name: path
outputs.description: The folder path, for sequencing further file nodes.

nodes.name: Directory.Delete
nodes.description: Deletes a folder (an empty one, or with its whole content when recursive is true); returns false when it did not exist.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The folder to delete.

inputs.name: recursive
inputs.description: True to delete the folder together with everything inside it.

outputs.name: deleted
outputs.description: True when a folder was deleted; false when there was no such folder.

nodes.name: Directory.Exists
nodes.description: Tests whether a folder exists at the given path.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The folder path to test.

outputs.name: exists
outputs.description: True when a folder exists at the path (false for files and missing paths).

nodes.name: Directory.FindFiles
nodes.description: Finds files under a folder by wildcard (several allowed, separated by ";"), sorted by name, date or size, with an optional limit - the newest file is sortBy modified + descending + limit 1.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The folder to search.

inputs.description: Wildcard filter on the file name ("*" and "?"); several patterns can be separated by ";" (e.g. "*.nwd;*.nwf").

inputs.name: recursive
inputs.description: True (default) to search sub-folders too.

inputs.name: sortBy
inputs.description: name (full path, alphabetical), modified, created or size.

inputs.name: descending
inputs.description: True to reverse the order (newest / largest first).

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Keep only the first N files after sorting; 0 keeps all.

outputs.name: files
outputs.description: The full file paths in the requested order.

nodes.name: Directory.GetDirectories
nodes.description: Lists the sub-folders of a folder as full paths (optionally filtered by a wildcard such as "2026*" and optionally at every depth).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The folder to list.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: Wildcard filter on the folder name ("*" and "?"); several patterns can be separated by ";".

inputs.name: recursive
inputs.description: True to include sub-folders of sub-folders.

outputs.name: directories
outputs.description: The full folder paths, sorted alphabetically.

nodes.name: Directory.GetFiles
nodes.description: Lists the files in a folder (optionally filtered by a wildcard such as "*.nwd").

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The folder to list.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: Wildcard filter; the default matches every file.

outputs.name: files
outputs.description: The full file paths, sorted.

nodes.name: Excel.ReadFromFile

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Path to the .xlsx file.

inputs.name: sheet
inputs.description: Worksheet name; empty selects the first sheet.

inputs.name: hasHeaders
inputs.description: True when the first row is a header row (it is split off into "headers").

nodes.returns: Dictionary with "rows", "headers" and "sheetNames".

nodes.description: Writes rows (+ optional headers) to an .xlsx worksheet; append adds a sheet to an existing workbook (foreign styles/formulas are not preserved).

inputs.description: Destination .xlsx path (missing directories are created).

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: List of rows; each row a list of cell values (scalar rows become single-cell rows).

inputs.description: Optional header row written before the data rows.

inputs.description: Worksheet name (Excel rules: 1-31 chars, no : \ / ? * [ ]).

inputs.description: True to add the sheet to an existing workbook instead of replacing the file.

outputs.name: path
outputs.description: The path that was written, for sequencing further file nodes.

inputs.description: The file to copy.

inputs.name: destination
inputs.description: The full destination file path (not just a folder).

inputs.name: overwrite
inputs.description: True to replace an existing destination file; false (default) to fail instead.

outputs.name: path
outputs.description: The destination path, for sequencing further file nodes.

nodes.name: File.Delete
nodes.description: Deletes a file; returns true when it was deleted and false when it did not exist.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The file to delete.

outputs.name: deleted
outputs.description: True when a file was deleted; false when there was no such file.

nodes.name: File.Exists
nodes.description: Tests whether a file exists at the given path.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The file path to test.

outputs.name: exists
outputs.description: True when a file exists at the path.

nodes.description: Computes a checksum of a file's content (SHA256, SHA1 or MD5) as lower-case hex text - handy for change detection.

inputs.description: The file to hash.

inputs.name: algorithm
inputs.description: SHA256 (default), SHA1 or MD5, in any case.

outputs.name: hash
outputs.description: The hash as lower-case hexadecimal text.

nodes.name: File.Info
nodes.description: Reads a file's name, extension, folder, size in bytes and modified / created dates; a missing file gives exists = false and empty values instead of an error.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: The file to inspect.

nodes.returns: Dictionary with "exists", "name", "extension", "directory", "sizeBytes", "modified" and "created".

nodes.name: File.Move
nodes.description: Moves or renames a file (creates the destination folder; refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite is true).

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The file to move.

inputs.name: destination
inputs.description: The full destination file path (not just a folder).

inputs.name: overwrite
inputs.description: True to replace an existing destination file; false (default) to fail instead.

outputs.name: path
outputs.description: The destination path, for sequencing further file nodes.

nodes.name: JSON.ReadFromFile
nodes.description: Reads a JSON file into dictionaries, lists and values.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Path to the JSON file.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: The parsed value (dictionary, list, number, string, boolean or null).

nodes.name: JSON.WriteToFile
nodes.description: Writes any value to a JSON file (overwrites; creates missing directories).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Destination file path.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: The value to serialize.

inputs.name: indented
inputs.description: True for pretty-printed output.

outputs.name: path

A dangerous stretch shorter than 'minPassage' also counts as safe (a person cannot fit through the break). Turn on 'showOverage' to print how far each dangerous run exceeds the limit on the image, ready for reports. Set 'units' to the unit your numbers are in (e.g. Meters) — documents often store coordinates in feet even when the measure tool displays metres. Wire 'lowColor'/'highColor' to replace the default ramp with your own two-colour gradient (low = safe end, high = worst hazard; the limit sits at the 50% blend), and turn on 'showOverage' to print each flagged opening's gap-over-limit on the image — ready for reports. Openings that reach past the limit are flagged and get a saved viewpoint. Set 'units' to the unit your numbers are in (e.g. Meters). Needs a live Navisworks session.

inputs.name: units
inputs.description: The unit every number on this node is in ("Meters", "Millimeters", "Feet", …). "document" = the document's own units — beware: a document often stores coordinates in feet even when the measure tool displays metres, so name your unit explicitly to be safe.
